title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models
abstract: DeepSeekMath is a domain-specific language model that significantly outperforms open-source models in mathematical reasoning, approaching the performance level of GPT-4 on academic benchmarks. It achieves this through a large-scale high-quality pre-training corpus and an efficient reinforcement learning algorithm called Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine you're trying to solve a complex math problem. You need to understand the problem, break it down into steps, and use mathematical concepts to find the solution. This is similar to how language models work, but with a twist. They can learn to reason mathematically by training on large datasets of math problems and solutions.

We introduce DeepSeekMath, a model that pushes the limits of mathematical reasoning in open language models.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
DeepSeekMath is trained on a large corpus of math problems and solutions, including chain-of-thought and program-of-thought examples. This allows the model to learn how to reason step-by-step and use mathematical concepts to solve problems.

The model is also fine-tuned using a process called instruction tuning, which helps it learn to follow instructions and solve problems in a more structured way.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
DeepSeekMath achieves state-of-the-art results on several mathematical benchmarks, including GSM8K and MATH. On MATH, it achieves an accuracy of 51.7%, surpassing all open-source models and approaching the performance level of GPT-4.

The model also performs well on Chinese mathematical benchmarks, such as CMATH and Gaokao-MathQA.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
DeepSeekMath has significant implications for the field of artificial intelligence, as it demonstrates the potential for open language models to achieve state-of-the-art results in mathematical reasoning.

This has applications in areas such as education, where AI models can be used to help students learn mathematical concepts, and research, where AI models can be used to assist in the discovery of new mathematical theorems.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
DeepSeekMath introduces several key innovations, including the use of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for reinforcement learning. GRPO is an efficient and effective algorithm that allows the model to learn from its own mistakes and improve its performance over time.

The model also uses a large-scale corpus of math problems and solutions, which is essential for achieving state-of-the-art results in mathematical reasoning.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
You can try out DeepSeekMath for yourself by using the DeepSeekMath API. This allows you to input mathematical problems and receive step-by-step solutions.

You can also experiment with different hyperparameters and training settings to see how they affect the model's performance.
